messages:
alex: Heads-up — noticed a p50 latency bump on paged Flash variants after the KV prefetch change landed in staging. Quick numbers: before = 26ms, after = 38ms on our short-seq smoke harness.

mira: ugh. which change? PR or config toggle? :thinking:

alex: PR #6789 (commit `abc1234`) added aggressive prefetching for KV pages when sequence < 64 to reduce cold-KV misses. I can repro locally.

sam: can you paste the microbench command? I'll run a few configs.

alex: using the microbench binary: ```./microbench --model gpt-small --mode stream --seq 32 --batch 1 --kernels flash-paged --profile``` Ran on a c5-gpu perf node.

sam: ran baseline (no-prefetch toggle) -> p50 25.8ms, p95 47ms. with KV_PREFETCH=1 -> p50 38.3ms, p95 79ms. raw output attached: ```latency p50: 25.8ms
latency p95: 47.1ms
KV hits: 89%
---
latency p50: 38.3ms
latency p95: 79.0ms
KV hits: 98%```

mira: interesting — prefetch increased hit rate but increased latency tail. sounds like synchronous page loads on hotpath. any kernel timing breakdown?

alex: yes, perf profile shows more time in `paged_prefetch_worker` and `flash_kernel_dispatch`. Flamegraph link (internal gist): https://redwood.gists/s/attn-prefetch-flame 

nima: maybe prefetch is blocking the GPU launch path while it waits for CPU IO. Did we pin prefetch to background threads? The PR moved from async queue -> direct prefetch on request path.

sam: bisected to `abc1234` indeed. Reverting to async queue (local hack) brings p50 back to 26ms. commit range for bisect: `a9f... -> abc1234`.

mira: can we try a hybrid: prefetch on miss but with `try_schedule_bg=true` fallback? Also test batching heuristics — prefetch may be preventing coalescing of nearby requests.

alex: I ran a small experiment: toggled batching window from 1ms -> 4ms. Results: with prefetch + batching=4ms p50=29ms p95=55ms. So batching helps reduce the extra overhead.

nima: that fits: prefetch does extra CPU work per-request; by increasing micro-batch window we amortize. But that increases latency SLO risk for 1-off low-throughput requests. We should make it adaptive: enable longer batch window when prefetch enabled and traffic > X rps.

infra-bot: CI perf-suite started for PR 6789 (run id perf-2026-03-17-09). Logs: https://ci.redwood/perf/6789

sam: quick kernel trace (nvprof-like) shows GPU idle stalls while CPU prefetch populates page cache. That suggests we should move prefetch to non-blocking path or pre-warm during KV writes.

mira: proposed action items: 1) revert direct prefetch in PR and replace with enqueue-to-bg-queue; 2) add adaptive batching heuristic tied to prefetch flag; 3) add perf test covering seq=32/64/128 with and without prefetch.

alex: agree. I'll open a follow-up PR to change to bg-queue + config flag. I'll add perf numbers in the PR description.

nima: also add a sanity check in kernel selector: if prefetch enabled prefer fused-attn kernel only when batch_size >= 2 to avoid frequent punishing single-request prefetches.

sam: sounds good. I can help add the microbench cases and the flamegraph snapshot for the PR.

mira: thanks — let's keep this thread for perf numbers. If anyone finds a quick mitigation we can hotfix to staging. :shipit:
